title: Peace Optimizer
description: High FPS Fabric modpack for smooth Minecraft gameplay.
body:
Peace Optimizer is a lightweight and powerful optimization modpack designed to improve your Minecraft experience with higher FPS, reduced lag, faster chunk loading, and smoother gameplay. Built for low-end, mid-end, and high-end PCs, Peace Optimizer focuses on performance, stability, and clean visuals while keeping the vanilla Minecraft feel.

# ⚠️ Attention Content Creators  
If you're making a video about Peace Optimizer, please support the project by:

• Sharing the official Modrinth page link in your description.  
• Giving proper credits to the modpack.  
• Mentioning Peace Optimizer in your video.  

Your support helps the community grow and motivates future updates! 🎮

# Key Features

## 🚀 Massive Performance Boost
Powered by powerful optimization mods like Sodium, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast, and ModernFix, Peace Optimizer improves FPS, reduces lag spikes, and delivers a smoother gameplay experience.

## 🌍 Faster Chunk Loading
Explore worlds more smoothly with optimized chunk loading and better world performance using Noisium and Concurrent Chunk Management Engine.

## 💾 Better Memory Usage
Mods like FerriteCore and Dynamic FPS reduce unnecessary RAM and background usage for improved stability on low-end systems.

## 🎮 Improved Rendering & Efficiency
Entity Culling, More Culling, and BadOptimizations reduce unnecessary rendering to improve overall game performance and responsiveness.

## ✨ Shader Support
With Iris Shaders support, players can enjoy enhanced lighting, shadows, and visual quality while maintaining strong performance.

## ⚙️ Stability & Fixes
Debugify, ModernFix, Packet Fixer, and other optimization mods help reduce crashes, stutters, and gameplay issues for a stable experience.

## 🔧 Advanced Configuration
Customize your experience easily using YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL), Cloth Config API, Sodium Extra, and Reese’s Sodium Options.
